versions.short: The resolution recognizes the cooperation and joint military partnership between the State of Iowa and the Republic of Kosovo over the past 15 years, and expresses appreciation for the efforts of the Iowa National Guard and Kosovo. It congratulates Kosovo's government and people on their commitment to advancing peace, democracy, stability, and mutual understanding around the world. It also thanks the Iowa National Guard, Kosovo, and the United States for their joint work in combating malign activities around the world.
